brief: CUSTOMER.REC card portrait for Juno Vex (customers.ts: Hexlight arcade handheld, dominant armSiphon, tiers 1-2), matching the existing Dex Marlowe card portrait's exact construction (ui-demos/kpos-shell/art/dex-portrait.png / card.html): a three-quarter headshot, direct gaze, 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, no text or speech bubbles or panel borders or lettering anywhere in the frame. She reads as a wiry arcade-regular teenager: hoodie with the hood down, a battered lanyard access card, faint under-eye shadow from too many late clears, a half-smirk like she already knows the machine cheats. Background a plain soft dark gradient only, no scene detail competing with the face. NOTE: no appearance canon exists yet for this customer; this order waits on the loremaster's ruling on customer figure likenesses (this cycle's gates) before art-lead spends any credits on it.
